comment: Base M68000 instruction table. mask/pattern/ea_mask mirror MAME's m68kdasm.cpp m_opcode_info table (base 68000 subset). form drives operand rendering; ext drives instruction length; ea_mask is the valid-EA-mode bitmap (Dn 0x800, An 0x400, (An) 0x200, (An)+ 0x100, -(An) 0x080, d16(An) 0x040, d8(An,Xn) 0x020, abs.W 0x010, abs.L 0x008, d16(PC) 0x002, d8(PC,Xn) 0x001, #imm 0x004). cycles are PRM base values. aliases maps MadMac spellings to canonical mnemonics.
